desc: Ideation: digit DP with (sum, product) state, zero-flag collapse, at most 9 digits so sum ≤ 81 and product ≤ 9^9, memoization keeps states tractable.

Implement count(x): digit DP via recursion with lru_cache on (pos, started, sum, product) for non-tight branches; zero digit after start sets product to 0 permanently; leading zeros don't affect product/sum; accept terminal if started and (product == 0 or product % sum == 0).
Implement beautifulNumbers(l, r) = count(r) - count(l-1), handling count(0) = 0.
Verify examples: (10,20)→2, (1,15)→10; sanity-check small ranges against brute force and edge cases l=r=1, r=999999999.
